correctness.rationale: Coordinate injectivity gives |C|≤q. A direct two-shift argument proves comma-freeness is equivalent to g(i)≠f²(i) for full-size codes; closure makes g=c f^{-1} c f. For q=2 this is impossible; explicit four- and six-symbol codes and disjoint block union attain the upper bound for every even q≥4. A complete 24-permutation census and an independent complete 496-pair word test both give six DNA optima, with 2+4 symmetry orbits. The two included executable verifiers passed.
